records.monitor_reason: A proposed gigawatt scale data center campus near Emporia says it will use some on-site generation, but no fuel, unit or capacity is named.

verifications.note: Names Kanza Park Place and on-site generation.
Names the Flint Hills Digital Campus at Emporia.

records.researcher_notes: Data Center Dynamics reported on June 22, 2026 that Kanza Park Place LLC proposed a campus of up to 1,000 acres in Lyon County near Emporia, with a combination of dedicated grid service and on-site generation. A television station report of June 2, 2026 covers the same proposal. The city approved zoning in July 2026 and said it was a land use decision only. No source names a fuel, a turbine or engine, a capacity or an air permit. I found no air permit notice for it. It becomes an add when a document names gas or diesel generating units.
